name: visualize-skills
description: Three skills, one house style: visualize-the-problem diagrams a confirmed bug/incident root cause, visualize-the-plan diagrams a proposed fix before you build it, and visualize-the-fix diagrams a just-finished coding task — instead of walls of text at each stage. Built for vibe coders who lose track of what's wrong, what's proposed, or what an AI agent changed. Renders self-contained dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagrams with a clickable glossary for jargon.

interface.shortDescription: Diagram a bug, a plan, or a finished change as a small diagram, not a wall of text.
interface.longDescription: Three skills sharing one house style, covering the diagnose → propose → resolve lifecycle. visualize-the-problem diagrams a confirmed bug/incident root cause — a symptom chain, a reproduction sequence, a hypothesis fork for competing theories, or a mechanism deep-dive. visualize-the-plan diagrams a proposed fix before you build it — linear steps, a phased plan, a Now/Planned scope map, a decision fork, or a rationale deep-dive. visualize-the-fix diagrams a just-finished coding task — classifying the diff into a causal chain, before/after refactor, sequence flow, or vertical deep-dive (cause → fix → why it works). All three render a self-contained, dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagram with a clickable glossary for any jargon in the labels.
defaultPrompt: Visualize the fix you just made.
Visualize the plan before you start.
Visualize the problem before proposing a fix.
